programmes.d: Mr. Bean discovers being in hospital isn't always a bed of roses. Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too.
Mr. Bean has to replace his landlady’s cat after an unfortunate ‘accident’. Whilst trying to redecorate the hall, Bean is obstructed at every turn by his landlady’s vile one-eyed cat.
Hilda’s is not pleased when her old vampire buddies, The Bat Pack, swoop into town for a visit.

Sabrina is having a tough week. Cassandra, Margaux, and Tiffany are being a pain at school. Her aunts blame her for a mess Salem made in her room. Even reliable Harvey seems to be ignoring her (a misunderstanding).
Cassandra asks Harvey to a school dance only to find that Maritza beat her to it. When Sabrina hears, she is crushed. She thought Maritza was her friend.
It’s fundraising time at both of Sabrina’s schools. Sabrina bites off much ‘more than she can chew’ and decides to win top sales at both schools, simultaneously at the same time.

Byron asks Emma for help with training the school's swimming team and Emma has some trouble deciding whether or not to help out in her current situation. Meanwhile, Lewis continues to experiment on the girls, which annoys Rikki.

Rikki sets Cleo up at a karaoke contest as a joke, where she is humiliated due to her lack of talent. However, her singing ability undergoes a dramatic change when, in spite of the girls' precautions, she is hypnotized by the full moon.
When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.

On a white wintry day, Vonderland celebrates, “Festivus Solarus." Verne becomes smitten with a pretty young, visiting Spanish astrologer, who snubs him when she realizes he is a Mortie. Verne feels like a misfit in both worlds, magic and Mortie.

ELSA, a young Giantess, becomes the newest student at the school and Cassy's roommate. ZARLAK takes control over LUCREZIA'S mind through a magic gemstone. He uses her to make it look like Cassy is tormenting Elsa, who finally runs away.
Gus has an incredible string of good luck culminating in his becoming the captain of the school's Soomer-crosse team. When Cassy becomes jealous of her pal's success.
When Gus and Cassy accidentally sit in Siege Perilous, the legendary throne of Galahad created by Merlin, they begin to return to their magical “roots.”

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Awakening
programmes.d: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programmes.d: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programmes.d: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programmes.d: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Big Ideas
programmes.d: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Secrets and Lies
programmes.d: Bella attempts to start a relationship with Will until she sees he's apparently got another girl. Lewis tests the magic Moon Pool water at school and attracts the attention of their Science teacher.
Trickery makes Marshall the new Harvest King, and he finds the king's traditional task no treat: he must venture to see the Eerie Wolf, which turns out to be a werewolf.
Marshall and Simon must really use their heads to crack open the real story behind a homeless man who seems to have lost his mind.

Kristin drives out to a small fishing community to investigate a local sighting of a sea monster. / Sixteen year old Simon's fascination with spiders becomes a nightmare when his turn of the century town is infested with arachnids of every variety.
Ten year old Jimmy is afraid to sleep in the dark. / While digging in Greece, a greedy Fortune Hunter searches out the ancient cave ruins of the Greek legend Medusa.
It's a dark and stormy night when Mildred and Camille's car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.
A Mad Scientist went missing in the 1930's.
When Rip's former girlfriend, Dr. Anderson, steals an Egyptian sarcophagus, hoping to clone an Egyptian Princess inside, the team must fly to Iceland to get it back.

Rip & Co. wing to Japan to investigate reports of a live Oni, the Japanese Demon. They discover that the Oni report is a cover-up for something even more fantastic: the discovery of the magical Daruma Dolls.
While diving around an old shipwreck, Rip and Samantha have their yacht stolen on the high seas by the modern pirates.
Rip, Cyril, and Sam travel to Cairo, Egypt to investigate the case of a woman put in a coma by the Curse of King Tut, after trying to buy contraband artifacts from the dead Pharaoh's tomb.
Logan encounters a group of aliens and doesn't pull any punches trying to find out what happened to his real father...
The Alliance attacks the alien safehouse in order to stop the renegade Logan...
The masked blader Phoenix is revealed to be Gingka's Father, Ryo who explains he went into hiding to fight the Dark Nebula.
Kyoya and Ryuga meet in an intense semi-final battle.
In the first part of the finals, Ryuga builds a special arena for his match with Gingka.
Gingka battles with a mutated version of Ryuga. Gingka uses the spirit of all bladers to free Ryuga from the dark bey and win.

When Harpy knocks Kong out with spider venom, Lua merges with his mind to bring him back.
The gang travels to Egypt to foil De La Porta's scheme to resurrect an ancient god of evil.
Sonic and Tails help an alien prince fix his space shuttle to return to his home planet for coronation to become king or else his younger brother will be crowned in his place and destroy Mobius.
Scott has to watch over Grandpa for the weekend while Grandma is out of town, but it's the same weekend as the school picnic. Grandpa tags along with Scott and his friends, leaving Scott embarrassed.

The werewolf mascot costume is stolen by the uppity Upson High boys, right before the big game. Scott and Stiles must outsmart the snobbish Upson boys in order to retrieve the costume, or they'll have to find a new mascot entirely.
Betty and the rest of the gang rescue Gleebo, a cute little alien who has crash-landed in Riverdale while trying to escape from two ugly aliens.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Big Monster on Campus
programmes.d: Moose's athletic supremacy is challenged when he is humiliatingly defeated by a super athlete from Riverdale's rival school, Central high.

'Pink in the Middle': The Panther's barbecue almost goes up in smoke when neighbor Aardvark tries to eat his boss, the Ant. 'Pink in the Poke': The Pink Panther delivers a singing telegram to a prison inmate who escapes and leaves Pinky locked up.

'A Nut at the Opera': When stage hand Pinky accidentally puts the opera's star tenor out of commission and must take over the lead himself. 'Hamm-N-Eggz': Hamm and Eggz royally mess up the wedding of the obnoxious daughter of a Mafioso hit-man.
When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met which also explained how Scratch and Grounder were created.
Sonic and Tails escape underground from Scratch and Grounder, but they are held captive there by a miserly mole named Spelunk.
Inspector Gadget saves Professor Frafkin, the world's leading scientist, from being kidnapped by Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget and Penny head off on a vacation in the country when they get a frantic call from the Chief that Dr. Claw has stolen an experimental missile.

Mr. Bean builds a supermarket super trolley. Nipping to the shops for a few provisions becomes a nightmare when a mile-long shopping list from his landlady and a clapped out trolley with a wonky wheel conspire to ruin his day.
Mr. Bean is forced to look after his worst enemy. After a head-on collision with the milkman, Mr. Bean’s landlady is rushed to hospital, leaving him to look after her odious one-eyed cat Scrapper.
